narrative: The June 6 Flowise CVE-2026-40933 is a textbook LLM-tooling weaponization: a CVSS 9.9 OS command injection in the MCP stdio adapter executing with host privileges, with a published PoC and mapping to the NSA MCP information sheet. A second CVSS-9-plus framework RCE in successive weeks makes the LLM-tooling-as-attack-surface premise concrete, though no kernel-LPE chaining appears.
remaining_gap: The Linux-kernel-LPE chaining leg is absent, and no IR post-mortem or CNA advisory yet names a full LLM-tooling-plus-kernel chain.
